QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Old Woman's Whereabouts
QuestInfo.0: You should take advantage of the calm and quiet to ask about the old woman who sent you that letter.
QuestInfo.1: You should take advantage of the calm and quiet to ask about the old woman who sent you that letter.
QuestInfo.2:
It seems the old woman visited Svarti twice, once right after visiting Kaptafel and again about two months ago. She returned home in case her granddaughter returned, but if she's still in the cabin in the forest, then she's in terrible danger!
Go the old woman's cabin beyond Grim Vale and warn her.
